description: This file implements the WaitCounter utility in the c10::monitor namespace, including dynamic backend management, synchronization, and instance handling for wait counters.

classes.name: DynamicBackendWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for WaitCounterDynamicBackend implementing WaitCounterBackendIf interface.

classes.name: WaitCounterImpl
classes.description: Singleton class managing wait counter backends and their lifecycle.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a singleton instance of WaitCounterImpl for a given key.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts all backends and returns context identifiers.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all backends using provided context identifiers.
